fields.label: Shift Type
fields.description: For an Internal Guard, this mirrors HR's Shift Type and cannot be edited here once the record exists — change the guard's shift in HR (Shift Assignment) instead.

fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: For an Internal Guard, this is synced from HR's roster and cannot be edited here once the record exists. Date + Time are separate fields, matching HR's own Shift Assignment / Shift Type split.

fields.label: Start Time
fields.description: For an Internal Guard, this mirrors HR's Shift Type start time.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: For an Internal Guard, this is synced from HR's roster and cannot be edited here once the record exists.

fields.label: End Time
fields.description: For an Internal Guard, this mirrors HR's Shift Type end time.

fields.label: Farm
fields.description: Not required — a shift synced in from HR's roster may not have one yet if this guard has no prior posting on record. Set it once you know where they're covering. For an Internal Guard, station/rotation isn't planned here at all and can't be edited once the record exists — HR's own roster is the source of truth for where they're posted.

fields.label: Section / Block
fields.description: The specific section/block within the farm this guard is assigned to patrol. Choices are filtered to blocks belonging to the farm selected above. Locked for an Internal Guard, same as Farm above.

fields.label: Synced From (HR Shift Assignment)
fields.description: Set automatically when this record was created by the daily HR roster sync. Blank means a Security Head created it directly.

Set automatically from the shift's start and end date: Scheduled before it starts, Active while it runs, Ended afterwards. Choose Cancelled to take a shift out of the rotation — that is the one value the automation leaves alone.
fields.label: Status
Internal Guard
fields.description: Cannot be reassigned once the record exists — this shift mirrors this employee's HR roster entry.
